verdict.rationale: Datadog's Monitors and Integrations directory (which lists 1,000+ tools) imply webhook-based notification integrations exist for alerts, and the API Reference could support custom automation, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents webhook notification configuration on monitors or shows it triggering remediation/agent workflows. missing for 10: explicit webhook notification docs for Monitors, a documented example of webhook-triggered automation/agent remediation, and independent confirmation of this working in practice.
